title: SseFrame::id None conflates 'no id' and bare 'id:' reset; reconnect re-sends stale Last-Event-ID
description: RFC 8895 §9.2 distinguishes three id states: no id: line (retain), bare id: (reset to empty), id: <value> (update). This impl produces None for both 'no id: line' and 'bare id: line'. The doc tells callers to treat None as 'no change' and retain the previous ID. Trigger: server sends bare id: to signal a reset (intended to clear Last-Event-ID). Caller follows docs, retains old ID, sends it on reconnect. Server resumes from wrong position. The representation cannot express the tri-state without a breaking type change.
